headline: SK Hynix Unveils $70 Billion Capital Return After Q3 Net Profit Surges
summary: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a seven-fold increase in third-quarter profit and announced a S$96 billion shareholder return plan, driven by sustained demand for AI memory chips.
why: SK Hynix is a major global semiconductor supplier, producing high-bandwidth memory (HBM) critical for advanced computing and AI hardware.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Earnings expansion driven by artificial intelligence chip demand and large shareholder payout plans lift equity valuation.

why_moved: Strong demand for AI memory chips propelled a seven-fold quarterly net profit gain and prompted a massive capital distribution plan for investors.
